as_told.title: ODNI's hieroglyph-on-a-UFO claim leaked to Jeremy Corbell

plain: A former government worker named Dylan Borland, who says a top official told him aliens run everything, is said to have made a drawing "of like a hieroglyph" while giving secret testimony to an intelligence watchdog. A guest named Jeremy Corbell says this was told to him by the ODNI, the office that oversees all US spy agencies, and Michels repeats it to Borland, saying the drawings were made for the ODNI. Borland himself says the information was leaked to Corbell illegally by the ODNI's inspector general office, and he frames the drawing as something seen "hypothetically on a UFO."
